title: Deliver the developer-only Attempt annotation flow

verify.summary: Fresh T3 verification independently passed the exact developer-only annotation HTML flow, FT-008 link, current-role and CSRF enforcement, no-store and sanitized rollback failures, protected-name isolation, calculation-ready stable Attempt result, real Chromium journey and complete disposable cleanup. Lifecycle remains unchanged pending task-scoped red verification.

Fresh adversarial verification found no material semantic defect or operator question after challenging the exact developer-only routes, current authorization, CSRF, no-store, failure rollback/redaction, missing-versus-missed behavior, stable Attempt locator, FT-008 link, owner boundaries and supported browser/state paths.

Autopilot closed TASK-097 after functional PASS and task-scoped semantic-pass. The accepted developer-only annotation HTML flow, FT-008 child navigation, current authorization/CSRF, no-store failures, protected-name isolation and calculation-ready persisted result are durably verified.

evidence_required: FT-010-AC-001 and FT-010-AC-003 RED: the current Attempt detail has no annotation child flow, so an authorized developer cannot record calculation-ready correct|false|missed ground truth and cannot distinguish missing from explicit missed through the application; GREEN: the exact no-store HTML routes create/correct/remove detection correct|false and person missed rows and expose only persisted rows with a stable Attempt locator to the calculation seam; decisive comparison: disposable application fixtures plus one developer browser smoke over representative Attempt evidence and an absent-annotation case with no mandatory detector-miss artifact; artifact: redacted flow evidence under .tasks/TASK-097-T3-FT-010-W2/.

FT-010-AC-002 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: before the name-bearing annotation surface exists there is no protected feature response to expose, and manufacturing such exposure would create the prohibited harm; alternative proof: post-change role/CSRF/stale-session matrix plus URL, HTML-escaping, structured-event, application-log and retained-artifact scans show names/annotations only to the current developer page and nowhere in operator/photographer/general projections; decisive comparison: the same disposable Attempt and synthetic annotation across allowed, denied, revoked, downgraded and injected-failure requests; artifact: redacted authorization evidence under .tasks/TASK-097-T3-FT-010-W2/.
purpose: Expose the accepted annotation provider through the smallest developer-only same-origin HTML flow attached to existing Attempt navigation, with current authorization and CSRF on every protected operation.
success_outcome: An active developer can create, correct and remove calculation-ready annotations from an Attempt child page, while missing ground truth stays absent and no other or stale role, log or general projection discloses participant data.
anti_goals: Do not add a JSON API, SPA framework, generic form system, annotation history, bulk editor, participant registry or Calibration UI.
Do not add annotation fields to the FT-008 base Attempt projection or expose promoted subsets, personalized session data or commercial Photo media.
Do not change staff roles/session semantics, structured server-event behavior, retention cleanup or production credentials.

forbidden_scope: Production staff credentials, operator/default Attempts/annotations and real participant names
Staff-access persistence/role semantics, promo state writes and direct diagnostics reads of promo tables
Calibration, promotion/retention behavior, JSON APIs, media upload/delivery and unrelated FT-008/FT-009 behavior
stop_conditions: Business authorization or annotation writes cannot remain diagnostics-owned with staff_access limited to authentication.
A correct flow would require a new role, JSON API, participant/dataset model, artifact upload or modification of the FT-008 base protected projection.
Names or annotations cannot be kept out of URLs, logs, structured events, denied responses and retained evidence.
T3 auth/browser probes cannot use disposable principals/rows, controlled revocation/downgrade, safe rerun, synthetic names, redacted artifacts and complete cleanup.

constraints: Primary business owner is diagnostics; the HTTP adapter obtains the current StaffPrincipal and backend only registers routes.
Use only the exact GET collection, POST create and POST item update|delete routes; successful writes return 303 to the no-store child page.
Evaluate current developer authorization on every read/write and use the existing CSRF contract on every mutation.
The FT-008 detail adds only a developer link carrying attempt_id; names and annotation values remain on the child page.
Escape names in HTML and exclude them from URLs, response prose, access/application logs, server events and retained screenshots/transcripts.
Use disposable current/revoked/downgraded principals, Attempts/evidence and synthetic names; clean every task-owned row.
Use the installed playwright cli for one real-browser smoke: an active developer opens Attempt detail, follows the annotation link, submits one detection annotation and sees the persisted value.
invariants: Only an active developer can read or mutate annotations; denied responses reveal no Attempt or annotation existence.
Missing annotation is rendered as absence and never synthesized as missed.
Every mutation is CSRF-protected, transactionally validates owner/target state and rolls back on failure.
HTTP, staff_access and backend wiring do not own or directly write annotation state.
verification_targets: Focused application/HTML fixtures prove exact routes, 303/no-store, create/correct/remove, valid target semantics, a stable Attempt locator in the calculation input, missing-versus-missed semantics and sanitized 404/422/500 rollback; Calibration calculations and drill-down remain FT-011 proof.
T3 authorization and CSRF matrix proves developer success plus operator, photographer, unauthenticated, revoked and downgraded denial without existence or stale-page disclosure.

playwright cli runs the single developer smoke named in constraints and stores its transcript plus post-submit screenshot at .tasks/TASK-097-T3-FT-010-W2/playwright-transcript.txt and .tasks/TASK-097-T3-FT-010-W2/annotation-created.png; source/response/log/event/artifact scans prove the synthetic name is absent outside the current developer child page.

Ownership/import inspection proves use of the accepted diagnostics-to-promo and diagnostics-to-staff_access edges with no direct foreign-table write, new role, JSON API or annotation field in the FT-008 base projection.
